A gladiatorial '''arena''' existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Loovria/Legends|Loovria]] sometime before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. While competing in the arena, the famous [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] [[Bowdaar]] learned that a group of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|enslavers]]&mdash;the same who had originally captured and enslaved him&mdash;were present in the stands. Bowdaar arranged for a "weapons malfunction" that ended with the particularly messy [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of the drunken Trandoshans, exacting his revenge.<ref name="Bowdaar" />

==Behind the scenes==
The arena on Loovria was first mentioned in the Codex entry for Bowdaar in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Bowdaar" />
